final: SELECT mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, (CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds)) / AVG(CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds)) OVER () AS relative_to_mean FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
